abilities.name: Blood Fury
abilities.description: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Hardiness
abilities.description: Duration of Stun effects on you reduced by 20%.

abilities.name: Command
abilities.description: Damage dealt by Hunter and Warlock pets increased by 5%.

abilities.name: Shatter Curse
abilities.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Instantly removes all Curses and Banes, and reduces all Magical damage taken by 5% for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Underwater Breathing
abilities.description: Underwater breath lasts 300% longer than normal.

abilities.name: Will of the Forsaken
abilities.description: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Instantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.

abilities.name: Cannibalize
abilities.description: 5 yd range, Instant, 2 min cooldown. When activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect.

abilities.name: Touch of the Grave
abilities.description: Your spells and attacks with a damage part have a chance (30% for casters, 20% for Paladins, Rogues and Warriors) to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health. 15 sec internal cooldown. Does not break crowd control.

abilities.name: War Stomp
abilities.description: 0.5 sec cast, 1.5 min cooldown. Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 2 sec.

abilities.name: Endurance
abilities.description: Total Health increased by 5%.

abilities.name: Cultivation
abilities.description: Instant. Cultivate a nearby herb, growing a duplicate you can harvest without requiring Herbalism skill. Each herb may only be cultivated once. In play it goes on a 15 min cooldown, though its tooltip shows none.

abilities.name: Plainsrunning
abilities.description: Gain 2% increased movement speed every 5 sec spent moving, up to a maximum of 60% increase. Taking damage or standing still will reduce this effect. Does not increase mounted movement speed.

abilities.name: Berserking
abilities.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Increases your spellcasting and attack speed by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: Health regeneration rate increased by 20%. In addition, 20% of total Health regeneration will continue during combat.

abilities.name: Beast Slaying
abilities.description: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

abilities.name: Rapid Regeneration
abilities.description: Channeled, 3 min cooldown. Regenerate 50% of your maximum Health over 6 sec. Any movement, action, or damage taken will cancel the effect.

abilities.name: Walk on Air
abilities.description: Instant, 1.5 min cooldown. Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

abilities.name: Skysight
abilities.description: 0.5 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Increases your movement speed by 15% for 15 sec. Used at an elemental convergence it also grants Charged for 1 hour, which raises the bonus to 30%. Charged persists through death and ends when you enter a raid.

abilities.name: Elemental Insight
abilities.description: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.

abilities.name: Wind Blessed
abilities.description: Increases your spellcasting, melee, and ranged Haste by 2%.

abilities.name: Ruthless
abilities.description: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 1%.

abilities.name: The Human Spirit
abilities.description: Spirit increased by 10%.

abilities.name: Perception
abilities.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Will to Survive
abilities.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Instantly removes all Stun effects.

abilities.name: Find Treasure
abilities.description: Instant. Allows the dwarf to sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap and sometimes increase treasure found. Lasts until canceled.

abilities.name: Stoneform
abilities.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Artisan's Precision
abilities.description: Increases hit chance with spells and attacks by 1%.

abilities.name: Big Game Hunter
abilities.description: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

abilities.name: Shadowmeld
abilities.description: Instant, 10 sec cooldown. Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Using this ability in combat discourages enemies from attacking you, but increases the cooldown to 2 min.

abilities.name: Quickness
abilities.description: Dodge chance increased by 1% and movement speed increased by 2%. Night Elf Rogues and Druids are harder to detect in Stealth as if they were 1 level higher.

abilities.name: Wisp Spirit
abilities.description: Transform into a wisp upon death, increasing movement speed by 75%.

abilities.name: Elune's Light
abilities.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Escape Artist
abilities.description: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Instantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Expansive Mind
abilities.description: Maximum Mana, Rage or Energy increased by 5%, whichever your class uses.

abilities.name: Engineering Specialization
abilities.description: Your gnomish ingenuity reduces the rate of engineering devices failing or backfiring when you use them by 20%.

abilities.name: Eureka!
abilities.description: Instant, 2 min cooldown. For 8 sec, your non-periodic damaging abilities cost 10% less (Mana, Rage or Energy) and deal 10% more damage. For Priests, your non-periodic damaging or healing abilities cost 10% less Mana and do 10% more damage or healing. Periodic effects get nothing from it; a channeled spell is not periodic. The Mage's own tooltip is the one that leaves out non-periodic.

abilities.name: Walk on Air
abilities.description: Instant, 1.5 min cooldown. Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

abilities.name: Read Leyline
abilities.description: 0.5 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Increases your Health and Mana regeneration by 50% for 15 sec. Used at a Ley Line it also grants Attuned for 1 hour, which raises the bonus to 100%. Attuned persists through death and ends when you enter a raid. Cannot be used while Innervate is active.

abilities.name: Elemental Insight
abilities.description: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.

abilities.name: Wind Blessed
abilities.description: Increases your spellcasting, melee, and ranged Haste by 2%.
